crossRefs.note: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed…
beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon…
He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.
Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.
They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

people.name: Beth-peor
people.line: Place east of the Jordan, where Moses was buried.

translations.web: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
translations.bsb: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
translations.kjv: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
translations.asv: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.
